exact_response: Yes. Some Indigenous individuals have participated in institutions that discriminated against others. Assessing that participation requires looking at their specific actions, authority, and circumstances—including whether they acted voluntarily or under coercion. It does not establish collective responsibility among Indigenous peoples or negate discrimination they have experienced.
